:::{#def-leverage}
#### Leverage

Consider a linear model fitted by [ordinary least squares](correlation-regression.qmd#def-ols),
in which observation $i$ has
[covariate vector](correlation-regression.qmd#def-slr-covariate-vector) $\vxi$
(a 1 for the intercept, followed by the model's terms at observation $i$,
such as $x_i$ and $x_i^2$),
and $A \eqdef \sumin \soprod{\vxi}$ is invertible.
The **leverage** of observation $i$ is

$$
\lev{i} \eqdef \vxi^{\top} A^{-1} \vxi.
$$ {#eq-leverage}

:::
